headline: SDP @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SDP 4.37 at STL 3.83, with a projected total of 8.21. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SDP: SDP moved +1.15 runs while STL moved -0.22, changing the projected margin by +1.37 runs. The projected total climbed +0.93, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -20.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andre Pallante has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alec Burleson, Jordan Walker, Fernando Tatis Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jase Bowen, Ty France because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
